# Praat interoperability fixtures

`praat-long.TextGrid` and `praat-short.TextGrid` are the same synthetic
annotation exported with Praat 6.1.38 (via Parselmouth 0.4.7). The files were
saved using Praat's long and short text commands. Both are UTF-16BE with a
BOM, as written by Praat for these labels. They include one interval tier
with an empty label, quotation marks and a multiline Unicode label, and
an independently populated point tier.
